metaUsage.intro: Since October 1, 2026 Meta charges every reply sent on WhatsApp. Each number gets 1,000 free replies per month; templates are always charged. Meta bills you directly.

metaUsage.disclaimer: Estimate with Meta rates for {market}: reply {service}, utility {utility}, marketing {marketing} per message. Meta bills by each customer's country, does not charge inside the free ad entry window, and the real invoice is in your WhatsApp Manager. Messages sent from the WhatsApp Business app are not counted.
